title: The hamlet, births spaced by the life table
about: `hamlet` with the person life table's `interbirth` 0.15 of a lifespan instead of 0.03 (world.overrides.species, merged over species.json at build): after a birth, both parents raise the child for 0.15 of a life (6 game days, 72 real minutes at this pace) before they can start another. With gestation 0.011, an eager couple then has at most one child per 0.161 of a life: twice the rate a stationary population needs per couple when every adult is paired, so replacement when about half the adults are (the hamlet starts with 4 of its 8 adults in couples; docs/TRIALS.md, "Births that keep a settlement's numbers").
